🔱 Garuda eagle king Vishnu mount born from sage Kashyapa

Garuda, king of birds and vehicle of Vishnu, was born to sage Kashyapa and Vinata. He freed his mother from slavery by defeating the gods and securing the celestial nectar (Amrita).
